notes.title: Functionality Improvement - Magnified Sights
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/a2b58fd06e3618455522f6a276163de279597e85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/0a71d0ee0c73a76d45d59c46bef3f0e72de8f16e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Grunt1914 has received a new update that allows players to magnify their shooting and aim down sight view through magnified sights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/d8a1d97fa12bda412c84d095b95eba427fe151ea.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This effect has differing properties on different sights, ensuring each sight feels unique. Certain sights can view larger magnifications and others smaller magnifications , it depends on the respective sight and the players needs.

This system doesn't replace the scoping system, this is for sights exclusively. Scopes will still zoom in based on field of view, and will still have much larger zoom ranges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/b7e0eadc7a0093354e4efa11b4efd84ea919e67a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This system will allow smoother and more intuitive aiming and shooting down sights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: Functionality Improvement - Updated Server List
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/a2b58fd06e3618455522f6a276163de279597e85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/a31dc811013dd46687f9c920ee461b42b75d0cde.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Grunt1914 has gotten a new selection of servers to boost the play-ability for players around the globe. These new servers mean that players in more obscure locations will be able to play the game at a much better network speed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/35366cde498d52f856ccc6eaca0afae8981644da.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

These lower pings will help players to enjoy the game more and provide a far more fair challenge to all players, as you can now play with people in the same network zone as you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/d438b842c5475772aaf39af839712da8d0a3b0c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

These new servers include areas from all around the globe, with the most notable one being a server in Johannesburg, South Africa. This one is most notable because the game has a large South African following and I (the developer) am from South Africa, making it easier and better to test the game for me too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/82a7f75fffa18ea99f07e61f8bc274404cb880b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

I hope that this will make the game alot better for those who previously suffered form lag issues, on the network side. To select the network region, simply find the regions button in the main menu and select from there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: New Weapon - Old Timer Throwing Knife
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/b1419d5ef6b544a6cdbc98e3266b5a57271dabb4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This is the update for a new weapon, the Old Timer Throwing Knife.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The Old Timer Throwing Knife was a very scarcely used weapon in among American infantry in world war history. This makes it a very interesting and exiting addition for Grunt1914.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/a551290495e5a3bddd8ef385d99a061f3a5a71fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Very few of these were ever produced and even then they were used mostly as a training weapon, not many saw the light of day, nonetheless any combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/b415c6748f7457ae875926315f265cb10cbed48c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This deadly weapon can be very difficult to master, but get it right and its deadly! Being a one hit one kill weapon, this is one of the most dangerous weapons in the entire game - if used correctly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/afaa6dc8cf6588d4420418a69224b0816bde5db5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The player can carry three of these per spawn and so is supplied with a few chances to hit and kill their enemies! Good hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: New weapon - Fedorov Avtomat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/b1419d5ef6b544a6cdbc98e3266b5a57271dabb4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/862a1d1b403889381c62528017cac0f8c9bbeef0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This is the update for a new weapon, the Fedorov Avtomat semi automatic rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/25e4e9d6e822b8c1810a80905555801795798ad1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The Fedorov Avtomat was used among Russian infantry in the great world war, although with a limited 3000 or so units built - it was quite scarce. This makes it a very interesting and superb addition for Grunt1914's weapons roster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/5a8693645c1e3e9d134cffc0a394983f36b181c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The Avtomat rifle was designed in accordance to the Chuachat, where the designer, Fedorov - took some ideas and design notes from the larger weapon. This meant that the Fedorov Avtomat was similar to the Chauchat, but much more mobile and lighter, making it an incredibly deadly weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/8bcde75465328060ced99a74f01e465a5a2bbb7f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The gun has a high rate of fire and a lightweight structure. This combines to make a very accurate and low recoil rifle that fires primarily in semi automatic mode as to not overheat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Mode - Hardcore Game Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/dc974b32a488077548241ee75cc644a817174a27.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/da0bc1af9e4c15f00c8e37b89a39fb4ef4aa4e7e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Grunt1914 now has a Hardcore game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/d9f3a32774ebfb9f1101b060f6f459e848ccfeff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This is the most difficult and challenging game mode in the game. In this game mode the player is left without any HUD or in game information that the player would usually have available at their disposal. The player is also unable to see from where gunshots come when being fired on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/023a68b240f3b057aa1b31f88e381395ba57fe89.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

In this game mode the player is also left without any abilities that usually are available to the player to select at will. This extra measure makes the game mode more strategic and allot more difficult to excel at. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/e88d45bbb1a9b61656c3c2ab6df63dbe29562c41.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

All of the maps are supported in this game mode, as the mode has no special requirements. Night mode maps are especially difficult on this game mode as spotting player can be very testing to achieve. The objective of this mode is similar to death-match, the player with the most kills when the timer runs out wins, or whoever reaches the score limit first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Grunt1914 now has a domination game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/4f6f1c60b4b45b54eb9cad7d1d4c5675201c85c4.png[/img]

In this mode the objective is to capture and hold all three flags on the map. The more flags you're team holds the more you're team's score grows higher. The team with the highest score at the end of the match wins the game. The premise is simple but the game-play for the mode is fast and strategic and lots of fun, especially with friends.

Most of the maps in the game support this game mode, barring three or four that aren't compatible. Domination brings something new and unique to the game and offers more elements of strategy than previously available. All guns and abilities are usable in this game mode, anything to stop the other team from getting those flags!

The M1909 Bolo Machete was designed to aid US soldiers with jungle foliage and heavy bushes that they often struggled to traverse. The machete turned out to become a great fighting weapon too, and was used for both a travel tool and a combat weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

It was designed to be carried as an additional melee weapon from its first production in 1909 to its final production in 1915. Only around 17000 were produced making them pretty rare.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/b1419d5ef6b544a6cdbc98e3266b5a57271dabb4.png[/img]

The Trench Raiding Club is a widely used weapon in world war history, especially in battles where trenches were prominent. This makes it a very interesting addition for Grunt1914.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/a01fb4ecf4b310f63714b149feac2242a5afbe04.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This melee oriented club is a handmade version of a more structured and mechanically formed club, with spikes or nails hammered through, to deliver piercing damage as an extra feature. These were often made from existing clubs or even sturdy branches or logs, with relative ease.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/8e5f59ee8b376aed8bad09ae3338edf1360f8698.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Because of its availability weapons like these were often made in bulk from small groves or logging encampments near battle sites. They would be given to soldiers as an extra means of protection or in some cases assault. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/91410af13d61c6d26f3cbedea41501e6cb802880.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This weapon has little stab damage, but excellent charge and swing damage, making it useful as an all round melee option, regardless of its slower speed. One hits kills are often possible with this weapon, if aimed at the upper body or head region of a soldier.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The Parker VH 1916 has double triggers, 16 inch barrels instead of the usual 30 inch ones and delivers some serious firepower.

notes.title: Functionality improvement - advanced graphics options
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/a2b58fd06e3618455522f6a276163de279597e85.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

In this update the advanced graphical selection and choices are vastly improved and expanded on. With this update all major post processing features that are used within Grunt1914 can now be tuned. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/96bbef833addc500fbc90df1b53e9d06a432f914.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

These settings include Ambient Occlusion, AntiAliasing, ScreenSpaceReflection, MotionBlur, Bloom, ChromaticAberation and Vignetting. These all affects performance and fine tuning the settings will get each player the experience they desire in terms of quality vs. performance. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/eaf81af46b62fe0063169fb278fb16d8eb0df2e3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This update aims to improve the experience for players that have difficulty running the game at maximum settings, by providing many more options to select or deselect. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/d6e4e8faa528a879c777effbda8bacac80006fc9.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

At the bottom of the graphics settings menu there is a ""performance bar", this shows the player what the current state of quality vs. performance is - represented by a color slider. All advanced settings are color coded to represent its level of performance. AmbientOcclusion for example is very intensive so its red, whereas Vignetting is very light, and is then green as a result. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The following screenshots show maximum vs. minimum settings. 

Minimum :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/7e20ce7a4651fc75cf2da6773ec52d20404c8df8.png[/img]

Maximum :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/69f875e05ce1696867c5c5eb1498bf7890e334db.png[/img]

As is clearly represented above, there is a huge gap between maximum and minimum settings, hopefully this will help bridge the performance issues for some players.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This feature is due to be altered further going forward.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: New map - Express
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/d669263e8600b8074325e66cb917d5f942b264bf.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This is the second update for a new map, called Express.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/ad4e3529680f21e73867575cfbf76cf1c6680379.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Express is by far the smallest map in the game and is suitable for very small team death-match games or as little as one on one death-match or gun-game rounds.  Shotguns, sub-machine guns and pistols will work best here, with rifles and machine guns being too slow and heavy to really challenge on this map. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/253857080e8b96a60c158553f4b6efe81dcf2cf3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Express has a multitude of boxes, crates, props and other such miscellaneous items strewn about on a train. The entire map is on a underground troop and supply train, moving between battles. The train contains a storage cart, and three barracks carts to explore and fight on. Access to the cockpit is locked.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/9a58d46b5d0beab332a90f955f3aa5e9b74b4e3c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This map is only an interior and as such only has the clear weather option. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/c91195cac5cb9f1418c8de8d2de8133bc5aa426f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This map is quite experimental at this stage, and as of yet it is unclear how players will find the experience. As such the map is due to change in the coming weeks based on player feedback.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: Functionality improvement - ammo stations
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/a2b58fd06e3618455522f6a276163de279597e85.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

In this new update ammo stations are introduced to the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/749eccae2ddd75f3db928b2ccdf908882940da4f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

These are placed randomly and strategically around the map and are there to naturally provide the players with more ammo when they run out of bullets. Combat can be fast and brutal and munition stocks usually drop fast in the heat of battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/a135e2e44a3860d1e71f5c24751e31a15e67fd25.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

They are intractable by simply walking near them, they then add a certain amount of ammo to your gun's available munitions. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/5eaaaaaad2ff3e93eb99ac061c9aac7099c936b7.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The stations are destroyed when depleted but re-spawn to the same location every 10 seconds once destroyed, ensuring the battle rages on! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: New weapon - Lewis gun
notes.notes:

This is the update for a new gun, the Lewis gun.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The Lewis gun is a classic in world war folklore and history, making it a must have for Grunt1914. The gun is of English origin and was mass produced in England during its early lifetime in 1914.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Using advanced cooling techniques the gun has a 47 round pan magazine. It has a incredible RPM of 600 in Grunt1914 and does allot of damage over a short period!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/3bec38d76b3707c145d652cdbc9c46f28f7b995a.png[/img]

Using this new weapon you are sure to become the ultimate run and gun grunt out there on the battlefield! Heavy style!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This is the first update for a new map, called Freight.

Freight is a smaller map than the rest of the maps in Grunt1914 and was designed specially for close quarters fighting. Shotguns, sub-machine guns and pistols will work best here, with rifles and machine guns having to take the back seat on this one. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Freight has an assortment of crates, boxes, barrels and containers varying in sizes strewn about the area to provide cover for grunts in the heat of battle. The map is as the name suggests a stockpile of goods and weaponry stored away for the troops in the field. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]
